facets.description: ClientResource management-permissions endpoints call isPermissionsEnabled/setPermissionsEnabled/resource/getPermissions unconditionally, so the V2 UnsupportedOperationException surfaces as HTTP 500
Token exchange calls canExchangeTo, which throws UnsupportedOperationException in ClientPermissionsV2
The ClientRemovedEvent listener in AdminPermissions (lines 77-95) calls clients().setPermissionsEnabled. With V2 active, this throws when a client is deleted
